# Thunderbird RFC 7986 CONFERENCE read/write scope

A single entry already works through generic properties: `setProperty("CONFERENCE", uri)` plus `VALUE=URI` and optional `LABEL` parameter. `CalEvent.icalComponent` exports unpromoted properties and their parameters, and storage persists generic properties/parameters. [Task 1]

Scope: general.
